{"ok":true,"ghost":{"id":"lumi-dev","namespace":null,"name":"Lumi（开发版）","command":"lumi-dev","recall":"初始化或打开 Lumi 项目、创作或修改故事与设定、逐章逐页保存正文与画面描述、审阅文本并导出作品。","manual":[{"name":"runtime","description":"诊断、只读限制、释放连接与共享服务边界。"},{"name":"project","description":"目录选择、原地 draft 与 setup、重复初始化、桌面切换与创作边界。"},{"name":"authoring","description":"项目识别、setup、故事、设定、章节和页面、文本审阅与导出，以及冲突、中断和额度耗尽恢复。"}],"tools":[{"name":"list_tools","description":"不传 category 返回类别概览；指定类别返回工具说明、JSON Schema 与必要 RULES。图片使用独立 receive_media 附件入口；review 尚未实现。","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"category":{"type":"string"}},"additionalProperties":false}},{"name":"call_tool","description":"执行 list_tools 返回的允许工具；args 必须是该工具的 JSON 对象参数。失败返回 schema 与自纠规则，不代理任意 MCP/CLI/HTTP/SQL。","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"args":{"type":"object"}},"required":["name"],"additionalProperties":false}},{"name":"receive_media","description":"接收 ghost_call.attachments 中恰好一张授权图片，校验原件并保存到当前任务项目。先 image_target 获取 target_uuid、slot 与 expected_revision。不接受路径、指纹或内联字节。","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"description":{"maxLength":12000,"type":"string"},"expected_revision":{"description":"Exact revision from the last read or render_prompt; required for every mutation.","minimum":0,"type":"integer"},"fit_mode":{"enum":["keep","crop","pad"],"type":"string"},"prompt":{"maxLength":12000,"type":"string"},"slot":{"enum":["page_image","setting_image"],"type":"string"},"target_uuid":{"description":"Public UUIDv7 from a previous read.","pattern":"^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$","type":"string"}},"required":["target_uuid","slot","expected_revision"],"type":"object"}}],"setup":{"state":"ready","revision":9,"groups":[{"id":"host:client_config:model-provider","mode":"any_of","items":[{"ref":"client_config:model-provider","kind":"client_config","label":"AI 模型服务","description":"使用插件声明的图片或视频能力前，需要先连接可用的模型服务","state":"satisfied","actions":[]}]}]}}}
